outcome.Summary: Implemented words.TopK in words/words.go: streams the input through a bufio.Reader with rune-level state machine (words are maximal runs of Unicode letters/digits; apostrophes kept only between two letters, trailing/leading ones trimmed; words lowercased with strings.ToLower; stop words matched case-insensitively via a set; read errors propagated, k<=0 returns an empty non-nil slice), then sorts counts descending with word-ascending tie-break and truncates to k. Also added words/words_test.go covering basic counting, case folding, stop words, apostrophe rules (don't, o'clock, trailing/leading, digit boundaries), separators, Unicode letters, tie-breaking, k>distinct/k<=0/empty input, read-error propagation, awkward UTF-8 chunk boundaries, and a 50 MB single-line stream. gofmt/go vet clean; `go test ./...` passes (exit 0).
